records.region: Guano Slough and Catlow Valley, Lake and Harney counties, southeastern Oregon.

records.completion_scope: Chosen opening, single stage3 mainstem FID9749, all35 stored parts and joins, Guano Slough and Guano Reservoir, Rock Creek Sinks approach, eastern Catlow wetland, Garrison Lake and the actual southern receiving-floor ending were examined at ordinary corridor scale. records.supported_name_scope: Guano Slough is a mapped western and northwestern reach-level identity. It is not established as the name of the selected cross-Catlow continuation, intervening lake and actual southern endpoint.

scope_limits: The cross-Catlow connection remains materially unestablished despite complete visual coverage of its surroundings; no physical impossibility or surveyed barrier is asserted.

records.geographic_disambiguation: Representative identity of the selected continuous Brock River drainage corridor, supported from the coastal named delta through all selected inland components by geographic continuity. records.completion_scope: Brock River is supported as a representative system identity. Three overlapping original imagery views cover the selected eastern opening, snow-covered lake/feeder sequence and outlet, all central and lower joins, and the fan-delta coastal terminal. Retained ARC4032024 names the matching fan delta as Brock River entering Darnley Bay. The individual inland waterbodies are not assigned river names. The unavailable park plan and unused fisheries lead do not leave a material correspondence gap because the selected geographic connection is independently covered.
records.supported_name_scope: Representative identity of the selected continuous Brock River drainage corridor, supported from the coastal named delta through all selected inland components by geographic continuity. Individual eastern waterbody/feeder names remain unassigned; this is not one scalar name for every lake or reach.

scope_limits: Formal Canadian registry status remains unverified; excluded CGN expanded/name-search records were not used.
The representative river identity does not assert that the initial feeder or intervening lake/widening has the same local or formal name.

Terminal correspondence concerns the continuous fan-delta and bay receiving setting; it does not select a present navigable or wetted distributary.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
